n1.speaker: doris
n1.text: Psst, dear. That lady with the badge. Look — "Baby on board". She's been standing since the market.

translations.fa: پیس، عزیزم. اون خانم با اون نشان. ببین — «بچه در راه». از بازار تا حالا سرپا وایساده.

branches.suggestion: Oh! Should I offer her my seat?
branches.suggestionFa: اوه! جام را بهش تعارف کنم؟

cultureNote.en: London's transport network gives free "Baby on board" badges to pregnant women, and "Please offer me a seat" badges to people who need one.
cultureNote.fa: حمل‌ونقل لندن به زنان باردار نشان مخصوص می‌دهد.

n2.speaker: doris
n2.text: It means she's expecting. Yes, offer it. Nicely. Not too loud — some people get embarrassed.

translations.fa: یعنی بارداره. آره، تعارف کن. با احترام. نه خیلی بلند — بعضیا خجالت می‌کشن.

branches.suggestion: Excuse me. Would you like to sit down?
Hi. Here, please take my seat.

recasts.echo: Would you like to sit down? Lovely.
recasts.better: Would you like to sit down?

n3.speaker: doris
n3.text: Look at her smile! "Thank you so much." See? A little kindness. Now, a man with a buggy is getting on.

translations.fa: لبخندش را ببین! «خیلی ممنون.» دیدی؟ یه ذره مهربونی. حالا، یه آقا با کالسکه داره سوار میشه.

branches.suggestion: Should I move? I'm standing in the space.
branches.suggestionFa: جابه‌جا بشم؟ تو جای مخصوص وایسادم.

n4.speaker: doris
n4.text: In the big space in the middle. But if a wheelchair user comes, the wheelchair has priority. That's the rule.

translations.fa: تو فضای بزرگ وسط. ولی اگه یه نفر با ویلچر بیاد، ویلچر اولویت داره. این قانونه.

branches.suggestion: So the buggy has to fold?
That's a good rule. Fair for everyone.

n5.speaker: doris
n5.text: If there's no room, yes, they fold it. Ooh — and there's Mr Okoro with his stick. Can you help him to a seat?

translations.fa: اگه جا نباشه، آره، جمعش می‌کنن. اوه — و آقای اوکورو با عصاش. می‌تونی کمکش کنی بشینه؟

branches.suggestion: Hello, sir. Do you need a hand? There's a seat here.
branches.suggestionFa: سلام آقا. کمک لازم دارید؟ اینجا یه صندلی هست.

branches.suggestion: Can I help you? Hold my arm.
branches.suggestionFa: می‌تونم کمکتون کنم؟ بازوم را بگیرید.

n6.speaker: doris
n6.text: Lovely. He's eighty-six and he still goes to the market every day. Now you have to stand! How does it feel?

translations.fa: عالی. هشتاد و شش سالشه و هنوز هر روز میره بازار. حالا تو باید وایسی! چه حسی داره؟

branches.suggestion: It feels good. I don't mind standing.
branches.suggestionFa: حس خوبی داره. وایسادن برام مهم نیست.

branches.suggestion: My legs are young. It's fine!

n7.speaker: doris
n7.text: In Iran, do young people stand up for older people?

translations.fa: تو ایران، جوونا جلوی پای بزرگ‌ترها بلند میشن؟

branches.suggestion: Yes, always. It's very important to us.
Yes. And we offer our seat to women too.
branches.suggestionFa: آره. و جامون را به خانم‌ها هم تعارف می‌کنیم.

n8.speaker: doris
n8.text: Good. Your mum raised you well. Some young ones here pretend to be asleep! Not you, dear. You're one of us now.

translations.fa: خوبه. مامانت خوب بزرگت کرده. بعضی جوونای اینجا خودشون را به خواب می‌زنن! نه تو، عزیزم. حالا دیگه یکی از مایی.
